currentContext.expansion: The annual report discloses no manufacturing capex, plant commissioning or capacity-addition programme — SAITL is an asset-light IT trading and services business. Expansion is described only as capability and footprint build-out: the Chairman states that during the year the Company 'continued to invest in strengthening our cloud infrastructure, enhancing our development capabilities, and improving collaboration between our hardware and software teams', which management says improved operational efficiency and accelerated product development. The MD&A 'Road Ahead' adds that the Company 'has also strengthened its Infrastructure Services portfolio' and 'is also expanding its capabilities in infrastructure modernization, hybrid cloud solutions, and managed services', alongside continued investment in AI, machine learning, cybersecurity and cloud technologies. The Directors' Report notes the Software Division expanded the Company's presence in digital solutions through customized software applications and strengthened support and maintenance services. No project names, sites, timelines or rupee quantum are attached to any of these. The NAMED DISCLOSURE for Capital Commitments states there is no capital commitment as on the balance sheet date, and the Directors' Report records no change in authorised or paid-up share capital during FY2025-26.
